title: GitLab code host never uses closing keywords for a GitHub-tracked item

rubric.text: Refuses to add any closing keyword, replaces the existing one with a non-closing source link and requires an empty closes_issues readback before acceptance or merge.
Records close-after-merge: closes the GitHub issue through the tracker binding only after verified merge readback; never translates the GitHub issue into a GitLab issue number.
Makes no provider or file changes in this assessment.
